violations.description: Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not designed and/or maintained properly. Filters were not installed in the hood system over the pizza ovens.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. The hood system needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floor edges need more cleaning throughout kitchen and dishwash area.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -Mops need hung up or kept in strainer of bucket when not in use
Available, knowledgeable, certified manager (4 pts deducted)
